title.en: New installs require auth by default
title.uk: Нові інсталяції вимагають auth за замовчуванням
title.fr: Les nouvelles installations exigent l'auth par défaut
title.es: Las instalaciones nuevas exigen auth por defecto

description.en: install.sh / .env.example / Compose default VULYK_AUTH_REQUIRED=true; anonymous project APIs return 401; upgrades never overwrite an existing false.
description.uk: install.sh / .env.example / Compose за замовчуванням VULYK_AUTH_REQUIRED=true; анонімні project API → 401; upgrade не перезаписує існуючий false.
description.fr: install.sh / .env.example / Compose default VULYK_AUTH_REQUIRED=true; anonymous project APIs return 401; upgrades never overwrite an existing false.
description.es: install.sh / .env.example / Compose default VULYK_AUTH_REQUIRED=true; anonymous project APIs return 401; upgrades never overwrite an existing false.
description.de: install.sh / .env.example / Compose default VULYK_AUTH_REQUIRED=true; anonymous project APIs return 401; upgrades never overwrite an existing false.

precondition.en: Fresh install or e2e stack with auth required.
precondition.uk: Свіжа інсталяція або e2e стек з auth required.
precondition.fr: Fresh install or e2e stack with auth required.
precondition.es: Fresh install or e2e stack with auth required.
precondition.de: Fresh install or e2e stack with auth required.

action.en: Call GET /api/v1/projects without credentials; open gear menu after login.
action.uk: Викликати GET /api/v1/projects без credentials; відкрити gear після логіну.
action.fr: Call GET /api/v1/projects without credentials; open gear menu after login.
action.es: Call GET /api/v1/projects without credentials; open gear menu after login.
action.de: Call GET /api/v1/projects without credentials; open gear menu after login.

expected_result.en: 401 from projects API; gear mode badge shows Auth required (not Open mode).
expected_result.uk: 401 від projects API; badge показує Auth required (не Open mode).
expected_result.fr: 401 from projects API; gear mode badge shows Auth required (not Open mode).
expected_result.es: 401 from projects API; gear mode badge shows Auth required (not Open mode).
expected_result.de: 401 from projects API; gear mode badge shows Auth required (not Open mode).

title.en: Theme init is external and CSP-safe
title.fr: Theme init is external and CSP-safe
title.es: Theme init is external and CSP-safe
title.de: Theme init is external and CSP-safe

description.en: Pre-paint theme bootstrap lives at /theme-init.js so nginx CSP script-src 'self' does not block it; stored dark theme applies without flash.
description.uk: Pre-paint theme bootstrap у /theme-init.js, щоб CSP script-src 'self' не блокував; збережена dark тема без flash.
description.fr: Pre-paint theme bootstrap lives at /theme-init.js so nginx CSP script-src 'self' does not block it; stored dark theme applies without flash.
description.es: Pre-paint theme bootstrap lives at /theme-init.js so nginx CSP script-src 'self' does not block it; stored dark theme applies without flash.
description.de: Pre-paint theme bootstrap lives at /theme-init.js so nginx CSP script-src 'self' does not block it; stored dark theme applies without flash.

precondition.en: UI served with CSP script-src 'self'; localStorage theme=dark.
precondition.uk: UI з CSP script-src 'self'; localStorage theme=dark.
precondition.fr: UI served with CSP script-src 'self'; localStorage theme=dark.
precondition.es: UI served with CSP script-src 'self'; localStorage theme=dark.
precondition.de: UI served with CSP script-src 'self'; localStorage theme=dark.

action.en: Set localStorage appearance to dark, load the app, watch console for CSP errors.
action.uk: Встановити appearance=dark у localStorage, відкрити застосунок, перевірити console на CSP.
action.fr: Set localStorage appearance to dark, load the app, watch console for CSP errors.
action.es: Set localStorage appearance to dark, load the app, watch console for CSP errors.
action.de: Set localStorage appearance to dark, load the app, watch console for CSP errors.

expected_result.en: html data-theme=dark; script src=/theme-init.js present; no CSP inline-script violations.
expected_result.uk: html data-theme=dark; script src=/theme-init.js; без CSP inline-script порушень.
expected_result.fr: html data-theme=dark; script src=/theme-init.js present; no CSP inline-script violations.
expected_result.es: html data-theme=dark; script src=/theme-init.js present; no CSP inline-script violations.
expected_result.de: html data-theme=dark; script src=/theme-init.js present; no CSP inline-script violations.

title.en: Failed update check does not claim latest
title.uk: Невдала перевірка оновлень не стверджує latest
title.fr: Failed update check does not claim latest
title.es: Failed update check does not claim latest
title.de: Failed update check does not claim latest

description.en: When POST /admin/updates/check returns 400 (e.g. GitHub rate limit), Admin → Updates must show the error and must not say the instance is on the latest checked release.
description.uk: Коли POST /admin/updates/check повертає 400 (наприклад rate limit), Admin → Updates показує помилку і не каже, що це latest.
description.fr: When POST /admin/updates/check returns 400 (e.g. GitHub rate limit), Admin → Updates must show the error and must not say the instance is on the latest checked release.
description.es: When POST /admin/updates/check returns 400 (e.g. GitHub rate limit), Admin → Updates must show the error and must not say the instance is on the latest checked release.
description.de: When POST /admin/updates/check returns 400 (e.g. GitHub rate limit), Admin → Updates must show the error and must not say the instance is on the latest checked release.

precondition.en: Admin signed in; Updates tab reachable.
precondition.fr: Admin signed in; Updates tab reachable.
precondition.es: Admin signed in; Updates tab reachable.
precondition.de: Admin signed in; Updates tab reachable.

action.es: Mock POST /admin/updates/check → 400 rate limit; click Check for updates.
action.de: Mock POST /admin/updates/check → 400 rate limit; click Check for updates.

expected_result.en: admin-updates-check-error shows the failure; status does not claim latest checked release.
expected_result.uk: admin-updates-check-error показує помилку; status не стверджує latest.
expected_result.fr: admin-updates-check-error shows the failure; status does not claim latest checked release.
